column1: # Orbitals (Switch 2, Deluxe Edition, update v327680, version 1.1.2.0)
# Shapefarm's two-player co-op game on Unreal Engine 5.6.1 (SDK MW+EpicGames+UnrealEngine-5_6_1 in main; SF_GLSL_SWITCH2 / SP_GLSL_SWITCH2 shaders), SDK 21.4.2 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2,
# Wwise sound, Bink 2 movies. Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk. Packed from a NUP container (scripts/pack_nup.py); the Deluxe add-on is a licence with no content
# a 3D field for two players, both sticks in use
# v327680 is the update's title version, the title screen says 1.1.2.0-178968 (the NUP carries no display version)
# The game sets near-zero NVN depth (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode); offline pipeline bases use main0_z.
# Unreal Engine 5.6: nninitStartup reserves one 62 GB region for the engine; the rewriter's engine-wide rules cut the FMallocBinned3 constructor call (the host runs Unreal's heap on a malloc zone,
# dm/tools/ue_malloc.py, hle_uemalloc.c) and give the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py, hle_svc.c), after the SDK's node area cut to 62 MB (sdk_patches.py, the
# SDK 21.4 rule). Engage's 5 GB block, as Yoshi and the Mysterious Book's: a 4.375 GB alias region for an iPhone (the Mac reserves 64 GB whatever this says). See the note's Memory section.
# 9 GB application pool as the Switch 2's. The NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on
# Two IoStore shader libraries in Orbitals-Switch2.utoc (global 4,515 and game 36,480 shaders) of NVN2 records (uepak.sage_record), written out as decoded archives by the NSP script's UE decode
